description: [docs.mzizi.dev] Run a read-only shell-like query (rg, grep, find, tree, ls, cat, head, tail, …) against a virtualized filesystem containing only the Mzizi documentation pages. A page at /some/page is read with `head -200 /some/page.mdx`. Each call is stateless.

command.description: A shell command to run against the virtualized documentation filesystem (e.g. `tree / -L 2`).

name: docs_query_docs_filesystem_mzizi
